text:
Sam: FYI — started driver+kernel rollout to eu-west h100 pool (547.01) at ~06:10 UTC, canary subset of 5 hosts.
Priya: seeing model-compile failures and a spike in 502/retry loops :frowning:
Mateo: digging logs, getting PTX linker timeouts and NV driver 'invalid-device-function' traces on a few hosts.
Jen: can you paste a minimal log snippet?
Mateo: ```
[2026-03-18T06:12:23Z] nvptx: link error: ptx version mismatch (required sm90)
[2026-03-18T06:12:24Z] Driver: kernel launch failed: invalid-device-function
[...stack trace truncated...]
```
infra-oncall: tagging ops — looks like an ABI mismatch between our compiled kernels and the new driver/ptx combo.
Sam: confirmed it's limited to the hopper/h100 SM90-optimized kernels; other GPU families unaffected.
Priya: impact summary: ~6% tail latency increase and ~1.2k failed requests in last hour, mostly long-seq generation and embeddings.
Mateo: failure correlates with sequences >2048 tokens — KV cache allocation path hits unsupported kernel variant.
Ops-bot: deploy_failed: recommend rollback for pool 'eu-west-h100-canary' :warning:
Jen: proposal — pause rollout, roll back canary hosts to previous driver (545.23), and enable the runtime PTX fallback (compile with older target) as a short-term mitigation.
Sam: agree. runtime fallback will raise per-token CPU/GPU time (~+12% unit cost) but keeps service available.
Priya: should we also consider pinning NCCL to previous build? not sure it's the root cause but worth listing.
infra-oncall: action items: 1) pause rollout (Sam) 2) rollback canary (Mateo) 3) scale critical traffic to an unaffected pool in us-east (Jen).
Sam: paused rollout and notified SRE rota.
Mateo: rollback complete on 5 canary hosts, error rate dropped back to baseline.
Jen: opened ticket with vendor (INC-4321), attached nvcc/nvdriver/nccl versions and kernel logs.
Priya: reassign to eng-runtime to add PTX/SM90 detection early in our compile pipeline and a smoke test for long sequence lengths.
Mateo: postmortem note: our gating infra didn't include driver+SM90 combo in pre-rollout matrix — add matrix entry.
Sam: agreed, schedule automated smoke for SM90/PTX combos and KV-cache heavy workloads before next driver bump.
Jen: :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: will monitor for 24h and then plan a staged re-rollout with stricter canary gating and kernel pinning.
Ops-bot: alert cleared.
